body: Bitcoin (BTC) traded near $61,300 on Thursday, June 4, 2026, its lowest level since February 6, after a three-session decline of about 13% pushed the cryptocurrency to the floor of its 2026 consolidation. My Bitcoin technical analysis reads the move as a test of long-standing support rather than a fresh trend, because a sharp intraday reversal lifted price back toward $64,000, close to the session open.
